identity.description: An attacker uses cmdkey to enumerate cached credentials on a Windows endpoint, which triggers a Cortex alert for suspicious credential access behavior. The detection looks for cmdkey usage with specific flags that reveal cached credentials.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

biocs.name: Cached Credentials Discovery with cmdkey
biocs.description: Detection of cmdkey.exe being executed with /list flag to enumerate cached credentials
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'cmdkey.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/list'

abiocs.name: Suspicious cmdkey usage for credential enumeration
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where cmdkey is used to list cached credentials without typical user context
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'cmdkey.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/list'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'cmd.exe'

xql_queries.name: Hunt for cmdkey credential enumeration
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'cmdkey.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/list'
| fields agent_hostname, action_process_command_line, actor_process_image_name
